limitations: This is not an ERC-4626 model and must not use exchange-rate share formulas.
Mutable index, pending yield, roles, gauge cap, and balances require same-block reads.

This knowledge model does not authorize runtime APIs; current source-alpha reader scope is owned by the Savings package documentation and accepted architecture. Deposit, withdrawal, stake, harvest, and claim writers remain unsupported.

principal.deposit: transfer amount MUSD in and mint exactly amount sMUSD
principal.withdraw: update and claim yield, burn exactly amount sMUSD, then transfer exactly amount MUSD out
principal.exchangeRate: one MUSD principal unit per sMUSD receipt unit

yieldAccounting.claim: transfer claimable MUSD separately; principal receipt balance and totalSupply do not change
yieldAccounting.transferBoundary: update sender and receiver against the current index before changing receipt balances

invariants: principal receipts and claimable yield are separate values
unallocated pending yield is not user claimable until a non-zero ratio is applied
rounding dust is not promoted to principal or classic MUSD debt
a gauge stake changes custody/accounting of receipts, not the underlying classic MUSD debt aggregate
